statement_en: Let \(\text{B}:=\{1,2,3\}\) and \(\text{H}:=\{4,5,6\}\). We want to order these two sets to form sequences \(b_1,b_2,b_3\) and \(h_1,h_2,h_3\) so that \[b_1h_1+b_2h_2+b_3h_3\] is minimized.
callout_body: 现在有两组数$\text{B}:=\{1,2,3\},\text{H}:=\{4,5,6\}$,我们现在需要给$A,B$这两个集合一个排序，使得形成一个序列$b_1,b_2,b_3$以及$h_1,h_2,h_3$使得$$b_1h_1+b_2h_2+b_3h_3$$最小。
